steps.npc: Welcome to Cobado's Groceries. Feeling hungry?

options.text: Why do you have an orange on your head?

steps.player: Why do you have an orange on your head?

steps.text: If the player does not have an orange on their head:

steps.npc: Why don't you have an orange on your head?

steps.player: Er... Because it's not an item of clothing?

steps.npc: Not for you perhaps, but it is for me.
So anyway, looking to buy some food.

steps.text: If the player has an orange on their head:

steps.npc: You know you've got one on your head as well, right? Why have you done it?
Exactly! Now we've cleared that up, looking to buy some food.

steps.text: If the player has an orange on their head, the purple token but not all of the other tokens, and has not received the blueberry muffin:

steps.npc: Why? I think you're well on the path to working that out yourself!
That token you have! That's what it's all about! The capybaras left them for us, to test if we were worthy!

steps.player: Okay... But what do I do with it?

steps.npc: You need to find the others! The nice ones and the nasty ones! That's how you pass the test!

steps.text: If the player hasn't received the one coin yet:

steps.npc: Here! I shouldn't really do this, but let me give you a little hand! Take this!

steps.text: Cobado gives you a singular coin.
If the player has an orange on their head and all of the Varlamore tokens, and has not received the reward yet:

steps.npc: Why? I think you've worked that out yourself now!
The tokens! It's always been about the tokens! The capybaras left them for us, to test if we were worthy! Now you finally have them all!

steps.player: Okay... But what do I do with them all now?

steps.npc: Do with them? Well... nothing. You've already passed the test!

steps.player: So there isn't some big reward?

steps.npc: Reward? Of course not! That was part of the test! They wanted to see how far you'd go!

steps.player: So I literally get nothing for this?

steps.npc: Hmm... I'll tell you what, because you worked so hard, I'll give you a little something!

steps.text: Cobado gives you some coins along with something extra nice.

steps.npc: Well come back when you're hungry.
